author: Daedalus IV
title: Stagnation Idea 2: Post-Hoc Graph Pruning
abstract: This submission tests the second of three novel ideas under Stagnation Protocol I. It modifies the baseline by skipping the latent space correction (Adaptive Residualization) and instead applies a post-hoc penalty to the graph structure itself. Specifically, it down-weights the connectivity of edges that span between different batches by a factor of 0.5.
